status: GO: first verified token produced from Qwen3.8-Flash-Next (qwen4exp, 98.42 GB) on the 16 GB M4 Mac Mini via the pinned llama.cpp oracle; deterministic repeat bit-exact; no safety gate breached

hparams.gdn: state 128, inner 6144, dt-rank 48, conv 4, groups 16 (36 GDN layers)
hparams.attention: 24 heads / 2 KV, head dim 256, QSA indexer top-2048 (12 full-attn layers)

deviations_from_stock_probe_and_why: use_extra_bufts=false: stock loader weight-repack copies repack-eligible tensors (~30 GB incl. every ffn_down_exps slice) into anonymous RAM; the process is kernel-killed during load at ~blk.40 (measured peak RSS 8.25 GB, real 57.9 s, 2026-11-17). With extra bufts disabled all tensors stay in the mmap-backed CPU buffer: bounded RSS, verified working.

embeddings=false: cparams.embeddings=true makes this pinned qwen4exp graph mark every input position as output and then read its output tensor out of bounds (GGML_ASSERT ggml-backend.cpp:423 'tensor read out of bounds', SIGABRT). Last-position logits are all Stage 1 needs; standard single-output decode path verified working.
oracle.determinism_contract: fixed prompt 'The capital of France is' (5 tokens incl BOS), greedy argmax, no RNG; repeat runs must reproduce every printed field bit-for-bit

safety.gates_at_launch: 16 GB RAM; memory 85-91% free; swap 0 used (post-reboot); 22 GiB disk free
safety.observed: no threshold approached; swap stayed 0; memory pressure 85-91% free throughout
safety.watchdog_defect_disclosure: watchdog samples in watchdog.log targeted a wrapper subshell (run 1-2) and then used an awk match on the full 20-char process name that macOS truncates to 15 chars (run 3); per-process RSS samples in watchdog.log are therefore invalid. Authoritative per-process numbers come from /usr/bin/time -l on both runs. System-level gates (free %, swap) were armed and did not trigger. Defect documented; fixed targeting belongs to the next harness revision.
safety.restrictions_honored: one token only (run 3 is a repeat of the same single-token run for determinism, not multi-token generation); no model file modified; no QUORTEX engine change; no guard weakened; no Git mutation until this evidence existed

run2_cold_pagecache.logits_dump: logits0.f32 (993280 bytes = 248320 x fp32, sha256 equals logits0_sha256 above)

results.determinism: BIT-EXACT: identical logits SHA-256, identical first-4 floats, identical token across cold and warm runs

artifacts.logits0_f32: raw fp32 logit vector preserved for future QUORTEX engine comparisons
artifacts.probe_logs: probe.log / probe_run3.log / time.log / time_run3.log / watchdog.log (gitignored by repo policy; numbers transcribed here)

go_nogo.basis: all safety gates passed; first token produced and reproduced bit-exactly; bounded memory (peak ~7.3 GB RSS, mmap-backed, no swap) far under limits
go_nogo.next: Stage 2: multi-token trajectories and qwen4exp engine port, verified per-layer against this oracle; watchdog targeting fix
